nearby: Pokémon Center northeast/east near North Boulevard

location.directions_from_north_boulevard_pokemon_: From Pokémon Center northeast of Jaune Sector 11, head WEST/SOUTHWEST toward Jaune Street below Wild Zone 19; the permanent gold arrows are on the SOUTH-side terrace building frontage west of North Boulevard. Confirm player red ring over gold arrow in supplied map zoom.
